description: Reminder to an international student that they must complete the in-person right-to-study document check before enrolment.
subject: Action needed: complete your right-to-study check before enrolment
body:
Dear $first_name,

Before we can complete your enrolment we are required by UKVI to record a right-to-study check. This involves verifying your passport and visa or BRP in person (or via our digital identity service).

What to do:
• Bring your passport plus your visa vignette / BRP card to the International Office during induction week.
• Or, if you have been invited, complete the digital ID check using the link provided separately.
• You will not be able to begin attending classes until this check is on file.

Student ID:  $student_id

If you have any questions, contact the International Office.

Kind regards,
University International Office
